title: The Missing Half of the Recipe (La mitad perdida de la receta)

scenes.title: La habitación cuatro llama dos veces
scenes.summary: Room 4's desk buzzer gives its signature double ring, and Evelyn brings the old green cloth botanical book downstairs to inspect with Hannah and Graham.

scenes.title: Entre las hojas de menta
scenes.summary: In Room 9, Evelyn lifts the missing bottom half of the berry-and-almond cake recipe from between pressed mint leaves, though an old raindrop blurred the final line.

scenes.title: Tres pequeños moldes de horno
scenes.summary: In the café kitchen, Tessa puts aprons on Owen and Hannah to bake three small test cakes with three different glazes.

scenes.title: La primera tanda está demasiado ácida
scenes.summary: After Arthur measures the lemon glaze for Batch One without his reading glasses, Graham takes one bite and declares it sour enough to polish brass.

scenes.title: La segunda tanda cruje con fuerza
scenes.summary: Owen unveils Batch Two with a heavy toasted sugar top so hard that his brother Caleb jokes he could use it to tile a courtyard roof.

scenes.title: El aroma de la página prensada
scenes.summary: Holding the smudged recipe card up to the Room 9 window light with Evelyn, Tessa spots a tiny orange-blossom sketch and smells wildflower honey and sweet orange peel.

scenes.title: Diez sobre diez a lápiz
scenes.summary: Tessa serves Tin Three brushed with warm honey and orange zest; Graham eats in silence, writes ten out of ten in his paper ledger, and asks for a second slice.

scenes.title: La estrella roja del piso de arriba
scenes.summary: Sharing cake in the courtyard, Caleb compares the four-card puzzle map to the second-floor wooden balcony and spots an old brass lantern ring right where the red star points.
